URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Jac. c.]
Contact of urine with chancre causes tearing pains, which affect whole organism. θ Syphilis.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Jac. c.]
Prepuce much swollen, could not be drawn over glans ; on attempting to do so, copious discharge of yellowish green pus. θ Secondary syphilis.
Chordee in gonorrhœa.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Jac. c.]
Dull pain under sternum on raising head and drawing breath.
